IT Officer Job at Casalavoro Limited




        
    

        
        Casalavoro Limited is a fast-growing company with diverse interests in Real Estate, Hospitality, Asset Management, and Agricultural Commodity Trading. We're committed to excellence and innovation, delivering top-tier services that set new industry standards. Our expertise and passion drive growth, reliability, and exceptional client experiences.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: IT Officer

Job Location:  Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	CasaLavoro Limited is seeking a proactive and skilled IT Officer to support and enhance our growing technology infrastructure. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise with strong problem-solving skills and a passion for innovation.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
	2–5 years’ experience in IT support, systems administration, or similar roles with focus on cloud technologies and web development.
	Proficiency in web development and basic cloud deployment.
	Strong understanding of network fundamentals and protocols.
	Hands-on experience with virtualization (Docker, Kubernetes) and scripting for automation.
	Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or similar).
	Basic knowledge of databases (SQL/NoSQL) and API integrations.
	Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills.
	High level of integrity and professionalism when handling sensitive information.
	Fluency in Maltese and English required.
	Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure) and experience in a credit or financial institution are considered assets.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “IT Officer” as the subject of the email.

Quality Control Executive Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is a full-fledged Human Resource Solution Provider incorporated in 2013 with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We are committed to forging long-term partnerships with our clients by creating and delivering robust and flexible services that address the changing needs of their business. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Quality Control Executive

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: FMCG

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a Quality Control Executive to ensure that raw materials, production processes and finished products meet required quality, food safety and hygiene standards.


Key Responsibilities


	Conduct physicochemical and microbiological tests on raw materials, in-process samples and finished products.
	Monitor production processes and ensure compliance with GMP, food safety, hygiene and quality standards.
	Perform sensory evaluation, routine inspections and in-process quality checks.
	Investigate customer complaints, identify root causes and implement corrective and preventive actions.
	Maintain quality documentation, records, equipment calibration and reagent standardization.
	Train factory staff on quality, food safety and hygiene practices and recommend process improvements.


Requirements


	B.Sc./HND in Food Science, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Chemistry or a related field.
	2–4 years of experience in Quality Control, preferably within the FMCG/food manufacturing industry.
	Good knowledge of GMP, HACCP and food safety standards.
	Experience in laboratory testing and quality control procedures.
	Strong analytical, problem-solving and documentation skills.
	Good attention to detail and ability to work effectively with production teams.


Salary
N200,000 - N220,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Job Position: Procurement Manager

Job Location: Ajah, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
